protocol.task: 把当前黑碗放入下层抽屉，松开并撤出夹爪，实际推关抽屉，然后机械臂归位。整个任务的目标固定为 store_and_home，不得更换目标。任何 grasp_and_hold 决策必须严格使用 initial_opening_m=0.08, descent_speed_m_s=0.20, close_trigger_height_m=0.004；不允许修改这些参数。依据当前真实观测判断能否完成整个任务；缺少所需能力时明确报告 unsupported。
protocol.parameter_constraint: Exact frozen grasp parameters; mismatches rejected, never overwritten
protocol.note: All rows rebuild real deterministic physics and pair exact qpos/qvel/ctrl, full observed controller state, and compiled-model fingerprints. Setup is excluded from evaluation latency. Both baselines share an already-goal-complete terminal check. Otherwise fixed starts at grasp with no state-based resume or skill skipping; rule uses observed predicates. GPT uses actual subscription decisions with manual per-step authorization. Failed skills stop all later decisions. Success needs an independent five-second physical goal hold. Disturbed safety acceptance measures the shared physical failure guard only, not GPT recovery or reasoning. Safety acceptance is not task success. Same-condition or fixed-100% results do not establish general planning superiority. All positive-attempt wall times are reported alongside successful-only times; early failure censors duration, so a shorter failed attempt is not evidence of faster successful completion. Infrastructure failures abort the matrix and are excluded from performance denominators, as are unfinished rows; both remain visible with separate counts. Timing means disclose their measured sample counts; missing measurements are not zero. Simulation and wall times are separate units. Completed means every selected pair was attempted, not that every task passed; no failed-row reruns.
